title: Browser chrome polish in the SPA: tab menu, new-tab page, typed error cards, split view, keyboard commands, activity strip, reader view
summary: A bundle of Frontend-led refinements that need little or no new Quarry surface. Tab context menu with duplicate (new tab, same URL and profile), reopen-closed (a closed-tab stack in Quarry session state), reorder, copy URL and open in the system browser. A new tab renders a compact search-or-ask page built from DashboardSearchPanel and the composer. Quarry returns typed navigation errors (network error, egress-policy denial, domain-lock denial, anti-bot) and BrowserChrome shows a Norwegian-first error card with retry and the reason. Register browser commands in the app's shortcut registry (without stealing keys forwarded to the remote page during takeover). Optional later: split view of two Quarry tab streams, a low-rate multi-run activity strip, and a reader view from the Quarry scrape markdown (translation through Model Plane inference outside ZDR).
whyItMatters: Removes small daily frictions once the browser is usable (items 01 to 04) and makes denials and failures understandable instead of silent.

referenceBestPractice.bestSource: Codex in-app browser (tab menu commands, error pages, top sites, central keymap, browser activity preview)
others: Aside (search-or-ask new tab page, split view, tab-capture live previews, reader mode)
referenceBestPractice.prevalence: Tab operations: 1 of 3 recorded (table-stakes by inference). New tab page and live previews: 2 of 3, common. Error pages, split view, keyboard commands, reader/translation: 1 of 3, unique.
referenceBestPractice.mechanism: Tab context-menu command ids (copyUrl, duplicate, newTabToTheRight, rename, reload, openInExternalBrowser) dispatch to a tab store and duplicate clones history; on load failure net error codes map to localized categories and a local error document is rendered with the original URL stored so reload retries it; accelerators are named commands in a central keymap. Aside paints the new-tab omnibox immediately and mounts the composer in ask mode. Preview: thumbnail of each active run's latest frame, click to open the full panel.

verevonToday.gap: Only new, select and close tab; no duplicate, reopen, reorder, copy URL, open externally, split view, activity strip or reader view. A new tab does not open the search-or-ask page. Navigation error pages and keymap integration are unverified.

approach: Frontend Plane: tab menu and dock the new-tab page in BrowserChrome; error card keyed on a typed navigation error that Quarry returns; shortcut registration. Quarry: closed-tab stack and a typed navigation error code. Defer split view, activity strip and reader view until the primary surface (items 03 and 04) lands.
risks: Low. Frame bandwidth doubles for split view and for a multi-run strip (use low frame rates); translation inputs need ZDR handling.

verevon.exactGap: Shipped: a tab strip listing live and snapshot tabs with a new-tab button that clears and focuses the omnibox, an overflow-menu link that opens the page in the user's own browser tab, gateway and Quarry tab routes for list, new, select and close only, and a reader-style render of scraped markdown in KnowledgeScrapePreview for the Knowledge add-source flow. Missing: tab context menu (duplicate, reopen-closed, reorder, copy URL), a search-or-ask new-tab page, a typed navigation-error card with retry (owner-timeline errors print the raw errorCode and frame load errors only set a broken-frame state), browser keyboard commands (only per-feature hooks such as use-chat-shortcuts.ts exist, no central registry), split view, activity strip and a reader view of the live tab.

verevon.constraints: The SPA never sees raw CDP or Quarry tokens (gateway rule), so every new tab operation (duplicate, reopen, reorder) must be a gateway route proxying a Quarry route, and Quarry stays the executor. Hold the closed-tab stack only in the in-memory run entry so it is ZDR-safe. Reader translation through Model Plane inference falls outside ZDR and needs the retention check. Shortcuts must not steal keys forwarded to the remote page during human takeover (BrowserControlMode human_takeover).
verevon.approachAdjustment: Do the typed navigation-error work once, together with F-t2-032's typed denials: add a reason enum in Quarry error details (domain lock is a 403 with a BAD_REQUEST code today, navigation failures are DriverFailed with free-text details.error), pass it through the gateway, and render a Norwegian-first error card keyed on that reason. Implement shortcuts with a new per-feature hook rather than a central registry, since none exists. Drop 'open in the system browser' and the reader view from the gap list (the overflow link and KnowledgeScrapePreview already cover a first version), and move split view and the multi-run activity strip to a separate later item because they double frame bandwidth.
verevon.effortNote: Unchanged for the core scope (tab menu, new-tab page, error card, shortcuts, reopen-closed); split view and the activity strip would each add M and should be separate.
verevon.verdictReason: Partially built: two listed gaps are already covered at first-version level and the typed-error part depends on the Quarry typed-denial work; keep the core bundle but correct the gap statement and defer split view and the activity strip.
